message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. The city’s noise‑enforcement process is handled by the **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** and the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** office, and you can also bring the issue to your local city council member if you want a higher‑level follow‑up. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1. Identify the type of noise** | • Residential or commercial
• Daytime (7 a.m.–10 p.m.) vs. nighttime (10 p.m.–7 a.m.)
• Persistent vs. one‑off | • Helps the city determine which ordinance applies | | **2. Call 311 (or 404‑656‑4000 for APD)** | • 311 is the city’s non‑emergency hotline.
• For urgent noise (e.g., ongoing disturbance), call APD directly at **404‑656‑4000**. | • 311 (online, app, or phone) will route you to the correct department. | | **3. Use the online “Noise Complaint” form** | • Fill out the form with details (location, time, description, photos if possible). | • https://www.atlantaga.gov/311/complaint | | **4. Contact Code Enforcement (if needed)** | • For repeated or commercial‑related noise, the Code Enforcement office can issue citations. | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (same as APD) or visit the Code Enforcement page: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/code-enforcement | | **5. Reach out to your city council member** | • If the issue isn’t resolved or you want a council‑level intervention, email or call your council member. | • Find your council member: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/council-members | | **6. Follow up** | • Keep a record of your complaint ID (from 311 or the online form).
• If you don’t hear back within a week, call 311 again or email your council member. | • Persistence is key; the city often follows up after a few days. | --- ## Key Resources & Contacts | Resource | Link / Phone | Notes | |----------|--------------|-------| | **City of Atlanta 311** | https://311.atlantaga.gov/ | Non‑emergency city services, including noise complaints | | **Atlanta Police Department – Noise Enforcement** | Phone: **404‑656‑4000** | Handles immediate noise disturbances | | **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** | Phone: **404‑656‑4000** | Issues citations for repeated or commercial noise | | **Noise Ordinance (City of Atlanta)** | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance | Outlines prohibited noise levels and times | | **Find Your City Council Member** | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/council-members | Contact info for local representatives | | **City of Atlanta Official Website** | https://www.atlantaga.gov | General city services and contact information | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Be Specific** – Include exact address, time, and description of the noise. 2. **Document** – Take photos or audio recordings if safe to do so. 3. **Use the Online Form** – It automatically generates a complaint ID for tracking. 4. **Follow Up** – If the noise continues after the first complaint, call 311 or your council member. --- **Bottom line:** Atlanta provides multiple avenues—311, the APD, Code Enforcement, and city council—to report and address noise complaints. Just choose the method that best fits the situation and follow the steps above.
